# PitchShiftSoundEffect

- Inherits [`SoundEffect`](soundeffect.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("PitchShiftSoundEffect")`

Raises or lowers the pitch without changing how long the sound lasts -- which `PlaybackSpeed` cannot: a chipmunk, a giant, a voice disguised.

**Members below are the ones this class DECLARES.** Everything its base
offers is on the base's page, which is what keeps one added member on
`Instance` from being a change to every page here.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Octave` | `number` | `1.25` | read/write | What the pitch is multiplied by, 0.5 (an octave down) to 2 (an octave up). 1 changes nothing. |
